steps.title: The problem
steps.description: Identify what you need to solve and who the solution is for.

steps.title: First contact
steps.description: Tell me your idea so we can discuss what the project needs.

steps.title: Planning
steps.description: We agree on scope, timeline and budget before work begins.

steps.title: Development
steps.description: I build the solution in stages and share progress for your review.

steps.title: Delivery
steps.description: We check the solution together and I walk you through how to use it. After delivery, maintenance can include updates, fixes and monitoring, depending on the agreed scope.

brief.intro: A project can start with a problem, a sketch or an idea still taking shape. Tell me what you have in mind and we can talk about what to build.
introPhrases: Share your idea. Let’s see what we can build.
A sketch on paper can start a good conversation.
What task would you like to take out of your routine?
What would you change about the tool you use today?
An idea you set aside can still be a starting point.
A launch page that introduces a new idea clearly.
Online bookings with time slots, reminders and rescheduling.
One place to receive and track requests from your team.
A form that gathers the details you need to prepare a quote.
A reminder when a product is about to run out of stock.
A portal where clients can follow each stage of a project.
A field checklist that fits on a phone screen.
A portfolio that tells the story behind each piece of work.
A search tool that finds documents by name or topic.
Connect your tools so you only have to enter an order once.
A reminder before an important deadline slips by.
A weekly report that shows what changed in stock.
A spreadsheet that could become a tool for the whole team.
A digital form that gathers the details of a site visit.
A catalog with separate retail and wholesale prices.
A page where customers can see if an order is out for delivery.
Appointments and follow-ups in a single calendar.
A sign-up page for an event in your neighborhood.
A space to organize lessons, materials and activities.
A website that welcomes readers in more than one language.
An app that logs field visits even without a signal.
A construction log with photos and notes organized by date.
A questionnaire where each answer guides the next question.
A members’ area for resources and upcoming meetups.
A map of accessible places to explore around the city.
A dashboard that shows where an approval is held up.
A system for scheduling the use of shared spaces.
A page for collecting applications and portfolios.
A tool that matches payments with the day’s orders.
A digital archive for searching through historical photos.
A new site that keeps your existing article links working.
A workspace to review files and keep a record of changes.
A workflow that routes cases to someone for review.
An interface that works with just the keyboard.
Spot duplicate records when you bring in spreadsheet data.
A prototype to try out an idea before investing in it.
What’s the smallest version that would be useful to you?
Tell me who will use the project and what they need to do.
Bring an example and tell me what caught your attention.
You can start by describing a typical day at work.
If an important date is coming up, it can guide the project.
What question would you like this project to answer?
Sometimes one small tool for a single task is enough.
A way to hear from the people who use the service every day.
Tell me what you’ve already tried and where you want to go.

offers.title: Company website
offers.description: Introduce your business, show what you do and give customers a clear way to get in touch.

offers.title: Landing page
offers.description: Focus a campaign or product launch on one action, from requesting a quote to joining a waitlist.

offers.title: Online store
offers.description: Organize your products and give customers a straightforward path from browsing to checkout.

offers.title: Custom ERP
offers.description: Bring orders, inventory and day-to-day operations into one system shaped around your workflow.

offers.title: Internal portal
offers.description: Give your team a place to manage requests, approvals and reports with the right permissions.

offers.title: Customer app
offers.description: Let customers book, place orders or manage their accounts from their phones.

offers.title: Field app
offers.description: Help teams record visits, complete checklists and update work orders on the move.

offers.title: Workflow automation
offers.description: Turn repetitive steps into flows that process requests, send alerts and keep records up to date.

offers.title: System integrations
offers.description: Connect tools through APIs so information moves with the work and teams enter it once.
